raw_segments.text: For, Dickon, thy master is bought and sold. A thing devised by the enemy. Go, gentlemen,
every man unto his charge. Let not our babbling dreams affright our souls. Conscience is but
a word that cowards use, Devised at first to keep the strong in awe. Our strong arms
be our conscience, swords our law. March on. Join bravely. Let us to it pell-mell, If not
to heaven, then hand in hand to hell.
